mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_data ( user_id, category_id, item_name, learning_time, learning_month, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{itemName}, #{learningTime}, #{learningMonth}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, category_id AS categoryId, item_name AS itemName, learning_time AS learningTime, learning_month AS learningMonth, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM learning_data WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
